meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 当您使用支持该技能的编码工具（如Claude Code）时，它会扫描并迁移旧版内存文件（如.seed.md、CLAUDE.md）到新的共享内存树，组织到索引中，并验证结果，使您的记忆能在不同提供商间使用。
howto.when: 在更新报告共享内存有破坏性变更后，或当对话中存在.seed.md、旧版CLAUDE.md等遗留文件时触发。也可通过说出“migrate memory”、“legacy memory”或“the agent forgot everything after the switch”短语触发。

say.note: 开始扫描并迁移遗留内存文件。

say.text: 我切换后代理忘记了所有内容。

howto.what_en: When you use a coding harness (e.g., Claude Code) supporting this skill, it scans and migrates legacy memory files (like .seed.md, CLAUDE.md) into the shared memory tree, organizes them in indexes, and verifies the result so your memory works across providers.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports a shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has legacy files. Also triggers on phrases like "migrate memory", "legacy memory", or "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch.
